RUNAWAY ORANGE AND BON JOVI?!!

Vote for RUNAWAY ORANGE to open for Bon Jovi! takes two seconds and you dont need to fill out any lame emial shit! Go HERE and click on Runaway Orange "The Laundry Mat" to cast your vote! Thanks!
posted by Kyle


01.17.06

NO-FI COVERS PRINCE!

NO-FI SOUL REBELLION was feeling a little bit ambitious so they recorded a cover of Prince's "Dirty Mind"! They have posted it on their MySpace. Go check it out. While you are at it add them as your friend! They are awesome!
posted by Kyle


01.17.06

WANT TO WATCH A GOOD DVD?

So Greg and I were up late working and we decided to watch the new Saddle Creek DVD, Spend an Evening With Saddle Creek. Anyone who is into any of their bands or even just music documentaries should pick up this movie because it is a pretty thorough explanation of the labels history as well as the rise of their artists. Check it out.
posted by Kyle


01.16.06

TOURS GALORE!

Head over to the tours page where there has been about 45 shows added! February is going to be a busy month for all the bands. THE BANK ROBBERS, SLEEPAWAY, NO HOLLYWOOD ENDING, NO-FI SOUL REBELLION, and SOCRATIC are invading almost every state in the country. If you haven't seen these bands live yet, you better check them out now!
posted by Kyle


01.14.06

RECORDING NEW RECORDS IS EXCITING!

THE BANK ROBBERS have finally finished recording their follow up to The Pattern Reversed entitled, Tomorrow Belongs To Me! This full length is amazing. It's filled with 11 tracks of masterfully written songs that are going to blow your mind. SLEEPAWAY has also just wrapped up the tracking of their No Milk Records debut full length! This record is also a gem that everyone is going to be gushing over! Keep a look out for both records this summer!
posted by Kyle

TOURMALINE FOR DOWNLOAD

TOURMALINE Strange Distress Calls is avaiulable for download for one day only! Today! Go get it and fall in love with this band. Go here to find the goods!
posted by Kyle

HAPPY NEW YEAR!

The year 2006 is the year of No Milk Records! We are extremely excited for the new year and to bring all of you some of the best records we have released to date. Keep your eyes peeled.

03.28.06

MAKING PROMISES DIGITAL SINGLE AVAILABLE TODAY!

Everyone head over to iTunes.com and download the first single off of THE BANK ROBBERS "Tomorrow Belongs To Me". It's only 99 cents! Hopefully this will tie you over until the release date on May 16, 2006. Tell all your friends! The track is called "Making Promises"! This track as well as "Spirit Of The Stairway" are now streaming over at PureVolume.com. Go listen now!
posted by Kyle


03.27.06

SLEEPAWAY FILL IN NEEDED!

Hey everyone! If you play guitar, don't go to school, and want to tour full time for the month of April, SLEEPAWAY needs someone to come on tour with them to play second guitar. This would not be a full time position, but would be a great opportunity for a guitar player to get tour experience and make some great contacts on the road. This tour includes shows with Waking Ashland, Kaddisfly, and Park and will hit the western half on the United States. If you are interested email the band at band@thesleepaway.com. While you are at it go listen to some new tracks from their debut record on PureVolume.com.
posted by Kyle


03.8.06

SERIOUS SHIT!?

So we usually don't post pictures in the news section like this, but some things deserve the attention. Here in NJ we all know of the classic prank "forking". For those of you that don't know what it is, forking someone is when you get a shitload of plastic forks together and you stick them in someone's lawn. The whole ordeal is a mess and just a general incontinence to said persons lawn. However in buffalo they role a little deeper than we do in NJ. This weekend Shawn from SLEEPAWAY had his house CONED! Yes your heard me, he was CONED! In total the perpetrators placed about 200 orange construction cones on his lawn. Though we feel bad that SLEEPAWAY had to pick up all those cones, our hats go off to those that preformed this dastardly deed. However, watch out cause SLEEPAWAY has something up their sleeves! Anyway here's the picture.

posted by Greg


03.8.06

NMR NEWSLETTER???

So dig this, we have a new newsletter up on the site, if you were signed up for the mailing list please sign up again because the old mailing list's database got all fucked up and all the address were deleted. If you wanted off the mailing lits this is the perfect opportunity for you becasue were starting over. So to recap....if you want on the NMR newsletter or you want to stay on the list please sign up! You'll need to confirm your entry into the newsletter by clicking on a link you'll recieve in an email. Take it easy everyone.
posted by Greg


03.8.06

ERIK FROM TBR IS AT IT AGAIN

So with all the Hawthorne Heights drama going on, Erik from THE BANK ROBBERS decided to film a little public service announcement about it. It is spreading like wild fire througout the internet. Read this interview with him at MTV.com. It's pretty funny. Take a look for yourself.
posted by Kyle


03.7.06

NEW SLEEPAWAY SONG ONLINE!

Sleepaway has posted a new song titled "What Are You Gonna Say When I Call You" from their debut full length on PureVolume.com. The record hits stores June 6th! Tell all your friends to buy it up!
posted by Kyle


03.2.06

NEW PICS OF TBR AND SLEEPAWAY!

Head over to the artist pages for THE BANK ROBBERS and SLEEPAWAY to see brand new bio pics! Both of these shots were taken by the soon to be world famous photographer Chris Skerstad. His work is amazing. His photography is featured in both upcoming records, THE BANK ROBBERS "Tomorrow Belongs To Me" and SLEEPAWAY's self-titled debut!
posted by Kyle


02.24.06

GENIUSES, THEIVES, AND FOOLS TOUR!

Everyone needs to get to one of the shows on this tour. All three bands are amazing. Socratic, The Bank Robbers, and House of Fools will be touring the northeast, midwest, and finishing up in Austin for SXSW. This tour rules!
posted by Kyle

04.30.06

NO MILK FRIENDS & FAMILY SAMPLER VOL. 5!

So the time has come for this year's edition of the NMR friends and family sampler. You will find new tracks from SLEEPAWAY, NO HOLLYWOOD ENDING, NO-FI SOUL REBELLION, THE BANK ROBBERS, HALIFAX and more! In addition there are tracks from many signed and unsigned artists throughout the country. Pick up a copy at Bamboozle today! We also have created a separate web site where fans can see the tracklisting and talk about the disc on a message board. Hit up the forum today! The site is nmr-ffs.gifcommit.com.
posted by Kyle


04.24.06

TBR PLAYING FREEHOLD MALL!

May 16, 2006 is the day when "Tomorrow Belongs To Me" hits stores everywhere! THE BANK ROBBERS will be playing a FREE instore at the FYE in the Freehold Raceway Mall in Freehold, NJ. The event starts at 6PM. They will be playing tracks off the new record as well as signing copies! As an added bonus anyone who buys a copy that day will receive a FREE mesh hat. Tell all your friends! How many times are you going to catch a sick band for free in a Mall!
posted by Kyle


04.20.06

INFEST HARDCORE AND METAL FEST!

NO HOLLYWOOD ENDING has been added to an amazing fest at the Stone Pony on June 11th. There are 3 stages with some of todays heaviest bands. Bands playing include THE DILLINGER ESCAPE PLAN, NECROPHAGIST, Broken Wings, Black My Heart, Full Blown Chaos, Despised Icon, Haste the Day, The Showdown, Flee the Seen, Chiodos, Sworn Enemy, From a Second Story Window, Cattle Decapitation, Animosity, Job For A Cowboy, Misery Index, Scars of Tomorrow, Calico System, Too Pure To Die, Inked In Blood, and many more! Tickets are now available from our store, right here. Buy one today!
posted by Kyle


04.11.06

JOURNEYS BACKYARD BBQ!

So THE BANK ROBBERS were added to the June 24th date of the JOURNEY's Tour. The show is an all day event with a 30 ft. halfpipe, Etnies Skateboard Team, Motocross Demos, and live performances from Matchbook Romance and THE BANK ROBBERS. The show is being held in the Parking lot of the Oxford Valley Mall in Langhorne, PA. Definitely check it out!
posted by Kyle


04.3.06

TOMORROW BELONGS TO ME PRE-ORDER!

The day has come! We have teamed up with Smartpunk to offer free posters and pin sets to everyone who pre-orders THE BANK ROBBERS "Tomorrow Belongs To Me"! It is on sale here now, go buy it kids! We also have it available on our site but you won't get the free poster and pins unless you order through Smartpunk!
posted by Kyle


04.2.06

SHOWS SHOWS SHOWS!!!

Head over to the tours page to see a ridiculous amount of shows. NO HOLLYWOOD ENDING will be hitting the road with Stars Turn Cold, and Widows for a month. SOCRATIC is wrapping up their tour with House of Fools and Tokyo Rose this month. THE BANK ROBBERS are embarking on a national tour to support the release of "Tomorrow Belongs To Me" on May 16th! SLEEPAWAY will be visiting the midwest and east coast with Park and My Getaway this month! HALIFAX has some scattered dates with Hawthorne Heights and From First To Last, as well as some WARPED TOUR dates! And NO-FI SOUL REBELLION continues to amaze audiences in the northwest! If you are near any of these dates check out these show!
posted by Kyle


04.1.06

NEW SLEEPAWAY, NO HOLLYWOOD, AND NMR MERCH!

Check out some sweet new threads we have for sale on our store! Brand new shirts from SLEEPAWAY and NO HOLLYWOOD ENDING! These designs are so hot they will burn you! We also have NO MILK RECORDS zip-ups for sale too! I know it's getting warm out, so we will only have a limited amount of these for sale. Start shopping now!
posted by Kyle

05.31.06

NEW HALIFAX TOPS BILLBOARD CHARTS!

We are proud to announce that the new Halifax record, "The Inevitability of a Strange World", has debuted at #1 on the Billboard Heatseekers chart! They also charted at #130 on the Billboard top 200! We are extremely excited for the band. If you haven't picked up this record, GO BUY IT TODAY!
posted by Kyle


05.12.06

THIS IS THE WEEKEND OF THE BANK ROBBERS!

There are a lot of cool things going over the next couple of days. Tonite we are celebrating the release of Tomorrow Belongs To Me with a 21+ show in Asbury Park, NJ at Club DEEP. The band will be playing a short set, then enjoying cheap booze all night. All the fun starts at 9PM. Sunday, May 14th is THE BANK ROBBERS CD release at Prince of Peace in Howell, NJ. They will be playing with all their friends in NO HOLLYWOOD ENDING, Learning Takes A Lifetime, Signature Escape, and The In Out In Out. Be there at 6PM for doors, it will probably sell out. And finally THE BANK ROBBERS will be playing a very special live in store at FYE in the Freehold Raceway Mall at 6PM on Tuesday, May 16th. This event is totally free and will be totally FREE! All information about the band can be found on their new site www.TomorrowBelongsToTBR.com.
posted by Kyle


05.2.06

PRE-ORDER SLEEPAWAY NOW!

The time has come to unleash the debut self-titled album from SLEEPAWAY! It is available for pre-order on Smartpunk.com here. Pick up your copy today because it's like purchasing gold! It's just that good.
posted by Kyle

SLEEPAWAY CD RELEASE SHOW!

After the last CD release show was cancelled, the band was asked to headline the Buffalo Icon with a couple friends including Speakerfire, and Standard of Living. The show will be taking place this Saturday, July 1st. This is definitely a show you do not want to miss.
posted by Kyle


06.15.06

MORE FYE IN STORES FOR THE BANK ROBBERS!

More FYE In Store performances have been added throughout the region for THE BANK ROBBERS. Long Island, Rockaway, Vineland, and West Nyack are the cities they will be appearing at. Tell all your friends.
posted by Kyle


06.11.06

MOXIESTAR PUBLICITY!

Check out an amazing publicity company, Moxie Star! They have been working the SLEEPAWAY record and doing a bang up job. Check them out for all your publicity needs.
posted by Kyle

BEST OF LUCK TO SLEEPAWAY

On June 9th Sleepaway will be playing a FREE instore performance at F.Y.E (Walden Galleria Mall ) at 7pm sharp! ( 2000 WALDEN AVE STE G203, BUFFALO, NY) This is going to be an amazing show! I'd like to send my personal well wishes to the band, Kyle & Ace because I was unable to attend. Best of luck guys and get home safely!
posted by Greg

TOMORROW BELONGS TO THE EVIL SOUND OF TBR AND SLEEPAWAY

Head over to TomorrowBelongsToTBR.com we've posted some new reviews and band features!!! Then once you've done that checkout EvilHasANewSound.com for the latest in Sleepaway reviews and features!! Two great sites, all for you! Damn No Milk your good.
posted by Greg

SLEEPAWAY CD INSTORES TODAY!!

Sleepaway's debut s/t CD is now available in stores acorss the country!!! If your store doesn't carry it, hassle them till they do! If that doesn't work you can always purchase a copy right here on the No Milk Records online store. Or just give them a listen and see if you like it, then decide whether or not to buy the CD.
posted by Kyle

SLEEPAWAY FEATURED ON PUREVOLUME!

THE BANK ROBBERS VIDEO FROM FYE INSTORE!

So we posted a song from the FYE instore, for all you out of towners! We have posted this on the 2nd splash page and a couple myspace pages. You can also watch it on YouTube.com. It's all the live sound. ENJOY!

Best of luck guys and get home safely! posted by Greg 06.7.06 TOMORROW BELONGS TO THE EVIL SOUND OF TBR AND SLEEPAWAY Head over to TomorrowBelongsToTBR.com we've posted some new reviews and band features!!! Damn No Milk your good. posted by Greg 06.6.06 SLEEPAWAY CD INSTORES TODAY!! Sleepaway's debut s/t CD is now available in stores acorss the country!!! If your store doesn't carry it, hassle them till they do! If that doesn't work you can always purchase a copy right here on the No Milk Records online store. posted by Greg


07.18.06

SUMMER IS SO HOT SALE!!!!

It's no secret that this summer is shaping up to be one of the hottest years yet! Luckly for you, the heat has drove us mad and No Milk Records has decided to have our biggest sale yet! You'll find poster, buttons, hats, tshirts and a whole lot more all marked half priced! This is for limited time only and some of the items on sale will not be manufactored again so check out our SUMMER IS SO HOT SALE! RIGHT NOW BEFORE ITS TOO LATE!!!!

07.17.06

THE BANK ROBBERS AND SLEEPAWAY ROCK BUFFALO TOGETHER!

SLEEPAWAY and THE BANK ROBBERS are going to be playing the brand new Buffalo Superstore July 29th in Buffalo, NY! The store is at the McKinley Mall and will start at 2PM. Both bands will be performing and signing copies of their new record! 2 bands for free! Let's get all of Buffalo to this event!
posted by Kyle


07.14.06

THE BANK ROBBERS IN BRAZIL!

THE BANK ROBBERS are going to be released on an International split representing the USA to be released this September in Brazil on Enemy One Records. The split is called, "We Are Not Enemies, But Friends". Check out the tracklisting here.
posted by Kyle

NO HOLLYWOOD ENDING MONSTER TOUR!

NO HOLLYWOOD ENDING will embark on their largest tour to date with Gray Lines Of Perfection. With over 30 shows, the band will be bringing along smoke and bubble machines, as well as their own lights. If you haven't had a chance to see this band live you better get to one of these shows! Go listen to a new track called, "Hot Without A Heartbeat", on their myspace now!
posted by Kyle

SLEEPAWAY RELEASED IN JAPAN!

SLEEPAWAY's debut full length is out now in Japan through Fabtone Records. The import features 2 unreleased B sides for those die hard fans. Pick it up if you love imports and need more music from SLEEPAWAY!
posted by Kyle

MORE FYE IN STORES FOR SLEEPAWAY!

More FYE In Store performances have been added throughout the north for SLEEPAWAY. Syracuse, Rochester, and Erie PA are the cities they will be appearing at. Come out and support this amazing band.
posted by Kyle

BANK ROBBERS NEED YOUR HELP

The Bank Robbers have been added to the BREAK Battle this Sunday, February 25, 2007. It's at the legendary Stone Pony in Asbury Park, NJ. Come support the band so they can play this year's BAMBOOZLE. They play a little after 8PM. The band has tickets, so contact them at their MySpace. There will be a special guest performing on Victory Records. Come hang!
posted by Kyle


02.19.07

PAPER IS FANTASTIC

So Lady Fantastic are currently on Long Island at Vudu Studios with producer Mike Watts recording their debut album, "Paper". It sounds amazing. They have been keeping some video updates on YouTube. Check the latest one out here.
posted by Kyle


02.16.07

What happened to No Milk Records and all the updates? I'm just being real with you man. Didn't you get beat on the scoop by absolutepunk.net?

Some of you might be asking yourself where have all the the updates been? There has been alot of crazy things going on at the office, things like BamboozleTV, delicious meals, and a leaking ceiling! But I must be brief as the office is crumbling around me and the time is ticking..I'll explain more soon. Anyway...tomorrow morning two convoys will make the treacherous journey through the frozen tundra to Long Island. Team 1 will be headed by none other than Kyse, a.ka. is Nyse, a.k.a icle, a.k.a Kyle, and Team 2 lead by myself, The Edgemin, and the audio wizard sometimes known as Teeb. There we will meet Mike Watts the producer for Lady Fantastic's new album, "Paper". We will film said events at the studio. Eventually you'll see it, and when you do you'll remember this ridiculous news post. Like I mentioned earlier, all will be revealed.
posted by Edgemin


No news in January!


What? Your stilll reading this... Fine! You want some news... We were hung over and EXTREMELY busy.

05.23.07

FOSTER GETS THINGS DONE

We want to give a warm welcome to the newest member of the No Milk work force, Rob Foster. He'll be heading up our video department and we are extremely excited to have him aboard. In the coming weeks he'll be sifting through the no milk tape archives, gathering the goods and getting things ready for the No Milk Record Friends & Family Channel on BamboozleTv. Keep your eye's peeled for more updates in the coming weeks. As a added bonus myself and Foster had a little photo session, check it out.
posted by Greg


05.22.07

WE GIVE ABSOLUTE THANKS

We just wanted to take the time to thank AbsolutePunk.net for the news post about the NMR Friends & Family sampler vol. 6. We frequent the site often and appreciate the exposure and support that they have given in the past, and continue to give our label.
posted by Kyle


05.18.07

LOOKIN GOOD NMR..

I know traditionally No Milk isn't known for its abundance of news posts. If you click through our archives you'll see many holes in time. Some going as far as three months with only 2 news posts. But lately things are looking different. In those lost months we were growing... gathering... and preparing for the summer ahead. We hope that you will grow with us as we reap the harvest of our bountiful crop that we planted in the fall.
posted by Frank Redtarp


05.17.07

NMR F&F SAMPLER VOL.6 RADIO?

Because we want people to hear new music we give out samplers every year at the Bamboozle Festival held in New Jersey. Because we know that everyone doesn't attend this festival we had to do more. We decided to put up a microsite for the sampler where you can listen to any song on the CD and at your own convenience. You should check it out, it's a good one. I personally have had it playing all day while I'm at work. You see I'm alone today at the office. Kyse had official personal buisness to take care of. With the radio stream of the sampler its like having kyse in the office all day long! Check it out for yourself NMR Sampler Vol.6 Microsite
posted by Greg


05.15.07

HOT SHOTS PART DUEX

We finally updated our personal web site KyleAndGreg.com. At one time this site held our design portfolio from our days in college. The site hadn't been updated in over 2 years. I felt it was finally time to give people the scoop on what's been going on. Learn about our companies from the past, secret hidden pictures, and so much more! GET YOUR ASS TO THE THEATER BABY!
posted by Greg


05.12.07

NHEASY OFFICIALLY ACTIVE

No Hollywood Ending will soon have a digital home at their new web site domain, NHEASY.COM. We just launched the place holder page, so settle down. But keep your eyes peeled around the start of June for a wild new web site. It will be so NHEasy to remember....
posted by Greg


05.10.07

DEATH TO THE FORUM

We took down the forum on our NMR Friends And Family web site today. The once mighty forum had been reduced to a who's who of spam and cheap porno sites, woven amongst it's threads like a crippling cancer. Be on the lookout for it's next of kin as we'll be releasing a new site with new features soon! Fuck the forum, we got something better.
posted by Greg


05.08.07

WE KILLED IT AT BAMBOOZLE

First off, I would like to thank everyone who stopped by the No Milk Records Friends & Family video studio. This the first year we did something like this and it was a HUGE success. We gave away a ton of promotional stuff including Volume 6 of our sampler and had a great time doing it. Everyone who helped participate in the Kickin It With Kyse booth confessionals did an amazing job. These interviews will be up online at Bamboozle TV shortly.

Frank Redtarp would also like to thank his guests for sharing their personal stories during the taping of Life's A Bitch. If you missed the show, keep your eyes peeled for the interviews with Halifax, No Hollywood Ending, Rookie Of The Year, Treaty of Paris, and T-Bird also online at Bamboozle TV in the near future.

Weekends like this are the reason No Milk Records exists. We made a ton of new friends, and had a great time hanging out with everyone. Thanks for the support from all our fans, friends, and families! You know who you are.
posted by Kyle


05.07.07

PLEASE HAMMER... DON'T HURT EM!

So this weekend while walking to our car late on saturday night, some of the boys from No Milk Records were lucky enough to run into M.C. Hammer! Hammer had played the Bamboozle festival earlier that night and was just chilling by his limo talking to fans. We were some of the lucky ones who got to him early, so we did what anyone would do in that situation. My friend T-Bird said "Yo Hammer, can I get a pic with you and my buddy?". He agreed and I went to take the picture of Hammer and my two fellow colleagues. However when I went to take the pic I realized that there was no way in hell I was going to have a picture of M.C. Hammer in my phone and not be in it, so I jumped in the photo and Kyse took the picture. Later that night we were lucky enough to run into Hammer again, however this time it was at the V.I.P. after party and Hammer was busy watching the boxing match on TV. So two Hammer encounters in one day and a photo to prove it, Bamboozle was fucking awesome!


posted by Greg


05.04.07

MAD PROPS TO THE ADHD CREW

Special thanks goes out to our boys Swine, Coin and Vulgar for their amazing work on the NMR Friends And Family Studio backdrops. We came to them last minute, the day before Bamboozle and they totally hooked it up! Faster than I could begin to imagine they tagged three amazing 11ft by 7ft back canvas drop cloths that we had brought over. They worked through the night to get it done for the next day and without them our set for the studio would have looked like shit! You can checkout the images on our opening splash page and soon you'll be seeing their work on two new shows debuting only on Bamboozle TV, Kickin it with Kyse and Life's a Bitch!
posted by Greg

Fuck the forum, we got something better. posted by Greg 05.08.07 WE KILLED IT AT BAMBOOZLE First off, I would like to thank everyone who stopped by the No Milk Records Friends & Family video studio. This the first year we did something like this and it was a HUGE success. We gave away a ton of promotional stuff including Volume 6 of our sampler and had a great time doing it. Everyone who helped participate in the Kickin It With Kyse booth confessionals did an amazing job. These interviews will be up online at Bamboozle TV shortly. Frank Redtarp would also like to thank his guests for sharing their personal stories during the taping of Life's A Bitch. If you missed the show, keep your eyes peeled for the interviews with Halifax, No Hollywood Ending, Rookie Of The Year, Treaty of Paris, and T-Bird also online at Bamboozle TV in the near future. Weekends like this are the reason No Milk Records exists. We made a ton of new friends, and had a great time hanging out with everyone. Thanks for the support from all our fans, friends, and families! You know who you are. posted by Kyle 05.07.07 PLEASE HAMMER... DON'T HURT EM! So this weekend while walking to our car late on saturday night, some of the boys from No Milk Records were lucky enough to run into M.C. Hammer! Hammer had played the Bamboozle festival earlier that night and was just chilling by his limo talking to fans. We were some of the lucky ones who got to him early, so we did what anyone would do in that situation. My friend T-Bird said "Yo Hammer, can I get a pic with you and my buddy?". He agreed and I went to take the picture of Hammer and my two fellow colleagues. However when I went to take the pic I realized that there was no way in hell I was going to have a picture of M.C. Hammer in my phone and not be in it, so I jumped in the photo and Kyse took the picture. Later that night we were lucky enough to run into Hammer again, however this time it was at the V.I.P. after party and Hammer was busy watching the boxing match on TV. So two Hammer encounters in one day and a photo to prove it, Bamboozle was fucking awesome! posted by Greg 05.04.07 MAD PROPS TO THE ADHD CREW Special thanks goes out to our boys Swine, Coin and Vulgar for their amazing work on the NMR Friends And Family Studio backdrops. We came to them last minute, the day before Bamboozle and they totally hooked it up! Faster than I could begin to imagine they tagged three amazing 11ft by 7ft back canvas drop cloths that we had brought over. They worked through the night to get it done for the next day and without them our set for the studio would have looked like shit! You can checkout the images on our opening splash page and soon you'll be seeing their work on two new shows debuting only on Bamboozle TV , Kickin it with Kyse and Life's a Bitch! posted by Greg

blocks.text: Jordan Colletti - lead vocals/guitar Mike Kamerman - lead guitar Bob Dawson - drums Dan Vosk - bass/vocals

blocks.html: When originally formed in 2000, this band was nothing more than 4 aspiring musicians with big dreams. Since then, ALL RIGHTS RESERVED has matured into one of the hardest working bands in the country. With numerous tours of the United States under their belts, they have left a trail of impressed fans in every state they have conquered. Sharing the stage with acts like All American Rejects, and MxPx, in addition to 3 performances at NJs Skate and Surf Festival has created an almost, telephone-like word of mouth hype throughout the country. Nine straight months of touring to support their debut EP, Remind Me To Burn These Pages (released 11-25-03 on Pumpkineater Records) has been both an effective advertising campaign as well as a highly positive marketing plan. With over 5,000 copies of the EP sold worldwide, ALL RIGHTS RESERVED was asked to join the Smartpunk Stage of 2004 Vans Warped Tour where they continued to win the support of crowds everywhere they play. For fans of Fall Out Boy, and My Chemical Romance. Sadly, shortly after signing with No Milk Records ARR finally succumbed to the pressures of the road and disbanded. Mike went on to join the widley known band, Rookie of The Year. Bob and Dan have been rumored to be starting a dance revolution and Jordan went back to school in Arizona. However all is not lost, check out the Huge Discounts on ARR merchandise available exclusively from No Milk Records!

faq.title: [ NO MILK RECORDS | F.A.Q. ] frequently asked questions, policy, facts

blocks.html:
Q. Where is No Milk Records located?

A. We're still in Red Bank, New Jersey but we moved to yet another office. This time its with the Long Haired God's of Rock N Roll, Merovingian Music. But don't get scared our p.o. box is still in Jackson!


Q. Can I email you an mp3 of my band?

A. We usually have to ignore requests to download files. The best way to get us to listen to your band is to send us a cd. We get so many press kits through direct mail every week. It's only fair that we listen to those first. Send everything to our P.O. Box: your cd, bio, video footage, lyrics, pictures, or anything else you want us to have. The more information you send us about your band, the more we can understand your dedication and goals.


Q. I can't get your CDs! Who distributes your records?

A. All of our records are available in Best Buy. If they aren't on the shelf they can order it for you. Don't be shy just ask the nice sales associate. If you want to get our discs in other stores, tell the clerk to order from the following distributors.

Our new distributor is Caroline Distribution and we are proud to be part of such a terrific organization. Starting with No Hollywood Ending's new CD, Everybody's Talking our newest releases will be listed in your Caroline Distribution Catalog. Our last three records starting with TOURMALINE "Strange Distress Calls" and ending with Sleepaway "s/t" are distrbuted by Fontana UNIVERSAL. HALIFAX "A Writer's Reference is distributed by Drive-thru Records/Sony BMG. All of our previous releases are distributed by numerous distributors including Harvest Media Group, Choke, Very, Playback Entertainment (Japan).


Q. I have a college radio show and I want promos of new releases to play on my show. Who do I contact?

A. Drop us an email and we would be more than happy to send you our material to play on your show.


Q. How do I get promotional copies of new releases for my fanzine/magazine/school paper/website?

A. Send samples to No Milk Records P.O. Box 1229 Jackson, NJ 08527. You can also drop us an email at press@nomilkrecords.com


Q. Can I intern for No Milk Records?

A. Of course you can providing that you have transportation to Red Bank. Send an email to work@nomilkrecords and tell us a little about yourself. We will warn you that internship aren't glamorous, but you will learn a lot in a fun working environment.


Q. Hey I want to do a compilation. Can I have a No Milk band on it?

A. Yeah we love kids who do comps. We did comps when we first started and they are great. Send an email to kyle@nomilkrecords.com and tell us about your compilation and why you want to put one out.


Feel free to email any other questions to sales@nomilkrecords.com

hx.title: [ NO MILK RECORDS | HALIFAX ] A Writer's Reference, Thousand Oaks, CA

blocks.html:
Mike Hunau - vocals

Chris Brandt - guitar/vocals

Adam Trabish - guitar

Tommy Guindon - drums

Doug Peyton - Bass
blocks.text: Mike Hunau - vocals Chris Brandt - guitar/vocals Adam Trabish - guitar Tommy Guindon - drums Doug Peyton - Bass

blocks.html:
Yeah, yeah. You know it already. Halifax can really party. Hell, even the old bag in the cubicle next to you probably knows them from their stint on The Real World Austin. But what’s decidedly more important is that the Thousand Oaks, California-reared quintet’s music translates. Just ask the million plus visitors to the band’s PureVolume page. But better proof lies with the band’s crackling debut album, The Inevitability of a Strange World, which finds frontman Mike Hunau, guitarists Chris Brandt and Adam Charles, bassist Doug Peyton and drummer Tommy Guindon at a distinct advantage over other booze-swilling, excess-extolling rising stars. Sure, many have tried through the years, but few bands have managed to bridge the great divide between rock, punk and metal with their hooks, hearts and hopes in tact quite the same way these electric warriors have.


More than mere trouble makers with guitars, Halifax are songcraft specialists with enough vision to merge the best of all possible approaches, which explains the group’s unique delegation of responsibilities to both Taking Back Sunday producer Lou Giordano and hard rock veteran Machine. “We loved working with Lou,” Hunau says. “His expertise was invaluable. But we wanted to put more ‘Oomph’ on the record, so Machine helped make it more aggressive. More in your face.” With that said, insistency abounds on The Inevitability of a Strange World. Be it the pop-meets-pummel charge of “Nightmare” or the irresistible, inventive first single, “Our Revolution.” The latter’s Mick Mars-themed riffs and rebellious “Hell yeah!” refrain qualify it as 7-Eleven parking lot music for the 21st Century. Says Mike, “It’s an homage to classic metal, and Motley Crue in particular.”


If Halifax’s melee-inspiring roar feels as woozily fun as it is proficient (few will be able to deny the exuberant crunch of “Under Fire,” for instance), it’s interesting to learn that the quintet’s influences vary from Nine Inch Nails to the Foo Fighters to reggae to Children of Bodom. “It’s almost like the music we listen to doesn’t necessarily shape our sound, as much as it helps to express what we are feeling,” says the singer.


From the coke-binge-gone-wrong theatrics of “Snow In Hollywood” to the stunning snarl of “Promise Me A Tragedy,” Hunau says most of the tunes in the Halifax songbook first germinate when he and Brandt collaborate. “It’s usually us coming up with a skeleton of a song and the lyrics and then we’re bringing it to the table and showing everyone what our version of it is,” he says. “And then everyone works on it together.” As frustrating as a rock democracy can be – Hunau says the sequencing of the disc was laborious due to disagreements – it’s this teamwork that eventually found the group a home on the infamous Drive-Thru Records label.


Rewind to 2003 and Halifax was just another in a myriad of unsigned but resolute indie outfits rolling the highways and byways of North America. Sharing van space, shitty hotel rooms, bodily aromas, Old Milwaukee and a collective dream in between crappy jobs in chain restaurants and landscaping, the group recorded and supported its initial EP, A Writer’s Reference. Within a year’s time, Halifax found itself among the lower echelon of the 2004 Warped Tour, but its reputation continued to grow. By early 2005, after establishing friendships with Drive-Thru founders Richard Reines and Stefanie Reines – and bowling them over during a New Jersey gig with The Early November – the label tweaked and reissued Reference. Appending an acoustic version of the band’s beloved “Sydney,” a track Hunau scribed in tribute to his late grandfather, Halifax continued touring and building its fanbase while concocting what would become The Inevitability of a Strange World.


When Mike, Chris, Adam, and Tommy landed in Austin, Texas for the renowned South By Southwest Music Festival last year, little did they know how a routine night in the world of rock & roll coupled with a few television cameras might sensationalize their image. “A lot of people who only know us from the TV will come to our shows and think we’re drunk off our asses or something,” Hunau chuckles. “But we didn’t do anything on the show that we don’t do normally. Bands go out drinking and get drunk and have fun and hang out with friends and chicks. It’s not like we’ll play with other bands and they’ll say, ‘Oh my god! Halifax is out of control.’ Yet anyone with an objective ear might garner such a notion in a positive sense by turning to The Inevitability of a Strange World. Take the contagious, exhilarating motion of “Better Than Sex,” for instance. Here, Brandt and Charles’ machine gun riffing escalates amid Hunau’s memorable, melodic intonations. Catapulted by the rhythmic drive of Peyton and Guindon, it’s evident that Halifax deserves the attention they’ve yielded so far.


If their intentions seem simple, they also seem pure. “No matter how shitty we’re feeling, there’s redemption when we go out and rock a crowd,” the singer acknowledges. “We definitely don’t just get up there and play our songs. We have a blast every night on stage.” Like we said, Halifax can party. Listen and live in the Strange World.

lf.title: [ NO MILK RECORDS | LADY FANTASTIC ] Hot Rod Hotel, Youngstown, OH

blocks.html:
Matt Cairns - bass/vocals

Kyle Donahue - guitar/vocals

Justin Giudici - guitar

Nick Kloss - drums
blocks.text: Matt Cairns - bass/vocals Kyle Donahue - guitar/vocals Justin Giudici - guitar Nick Kloss - drums

blocks.html:
This is what you get when you learn all your lessons the hard way. Write some songs, practice, record, book shows, buy a van, hit the road, then do it again. This is what we do. We never waited for that record deal or label interest to get started, this is going to be our life, and we will do it with or without help.


Our music is ever-evolving; influenced by our collective taste in music. Wed be lying if we said our style has never changed. Weve grown up as a band and as people, and our music reflects that. We call what we do progressive punk rock. Were not buying in to any specific genre or its uniform. Its more like calling in whats good about everything and cutting out the crap.


Hot Rod Hotel works kind of like a story. We wanted to write an album that was cohesive, but not necessarily a concept album. The idea: Make it feel like a walk through a hotel, and while passing each room, get the story that is going on inside. Musically, there is a lot going on; organs, strings, piano, and percussion all add to the mood and help create an atmosphere. Dual leading vocals help to define characters. Its heavy at times, and soft others.

nhe.title: [ NO MILK RECORDS | NO HOLLYWOOD ENDING ] howell jackson NJ no milk records band

blocks.html:
Frankie O - Lead Vocals

CLC - Guitar / Vocals

Ryan Lesinski - Guitar / Vocals

Kyle Mohr - Synth / Vocals

Joe B. - Bass

Steve Gotthelf - Drums
blocks.text: Frankie O - Lead Vocals CLC - Guitar / Vocals Ryan Lesinski - Guitar / Vocals Kyle Mohr - Synth / Vocals Joe B. - Bass Steve Gotthelf - Drums

blocks.html:
No Hollywood Endings latest album will choke you at the throat and leave you spitting out verses that are reliable, quick, accurate and to the point, as guitarist and vocalist, CLC, describes their latest gutsy creation.

Looking back on their first album, Its All a Nightmare released in 2004, No Hollywood Ending thought they knew what it took to bring their band to the main stage. At the time when it first came out, we were really excited about it and I think that we were on to something that nobody was doing at the time, says lead singer, Frank Osler. Now with their second full-length album, Everybodys Talking, the band has completely transformed.

Over the years No Hollywood Ending faced some struggling encounters that challenged the band to remain as serious, focused, and united as they had hoped. With plans being made for their second album, they realized that if NHE was going to progress and grow as a band then they needed to crack down and focus on what was most important, and they did. I hate looking back. I just like moving forward, says CLC who is already getting amped about working on their third album with fellow band members, Osler, Ryan Lesinski (guitar), Steve Gotthelf (drums), and recent additions Kyle Mohr (synth/keys), and Joe Beninato (bass).

With Its All a Nightmare, Osler feels that they were just a group of kids attempting to write good music, but now with Everybodys Talking, he is really proud of what they have accomplished and says that, The biggest difference is we learned how to write songs. We learned how to write them better and then finally, we all just stepped up and everything worked out perfectly.

No Hollywood was able to deliver the hardcore sounds that frenzied fans expected of them, yet the band was still able to surprise them with songs that were creative and fresh.

Sixteen Times is a big step for us. That is probably the best song we wrote, Osler says, whose lyrics withhold a catchier tone on this track. I know you like that, Confident, conceited, charming when needed.I know you like that,A boy so admired, handsome and desired.

Were good at mixing it up, says Osler. We know how to write the hooks and then we know how to keep it heavy for the kids that want to hear the heavy shit we started out doing. The tracks on Everybodys Talking range from hand-clapping chants with more up-beat guitar sounds presented in ChaChaChastity, to the more hardcore songs with lyrics thatll slap you in the face as seen in Obituary Cover Girl. CLC says that, In this kind of music we just play for kids to go crazy. Theyre just there to have a good time for 40 minutes, go crazy as possible and drive home sweaty. Playing a ridiculous live show for the fans and having fun on stage is what NHE has been about since day one, says Osler.

As for challenging themselves musically, NHE just might shock everyone with something highly unanticipated: a fifteen minute bonus track thats a massive medley of eclectic sound effects with an experimental flair, overlapping voice-overs, and lengthy, un-used riffs thatll make your head spin, as CLC describes his favorite part about the album.

The name of the album is Everybodys Talking. Everybodys talking everywhere at all times. People are talking somewhere right nowin the next house, the next town, or the next country, says CLC as he explains the albums title which was inspired by the unexpected final track. Even producer, Mike Turner, got a big hit out of the idea. He let us try things, says Osler.

The bottom line is, with music and lyrics like No Hollywood Endings slicing through the airwaves, theyre bound to make an impact on some level. I really dont know what to expect, says CLC regarding the future of the band. Just take the band as far as we can take it.

Looking back on their first album, Its All a Nightmare released in 2004, No Hollywood Ending thought they knew what it took to bring their band to the main stage. At the time when it first came out, we were really excited about it and I think that we were on to something that nobody was doing at the time, says lead singer, Frank Osler. Now with their second full-length album, Everybodys Talking, the band has completely transformed. Over the years No Hollywood Ending faced some struggling encounters that challenged the band to remain as serious, focused, and united as they had hoped. With plans being made for their second album, they realized that if NHE was going to progress and grow as a band then they needed to crack down and focus on what was most important, and they did. I hate looking back. I just like moving forward, says CLC who is already getting amped about working on their third album with fellow band members, Osler, Ryan Lesinski (guitar), Steve Gotthelf (drums), and recent additions Kyle Mohr (synth/keys), and Joe Beninato (bass). With Its All a Nightmare, Osler feels that they were just a group of kids attempting to write good music, but now with Everybodys Talking, he is really proud of what they have accomplished and says that, The biggest difference is we learned how to write songs. We learned how to write them better and then finally, we all just stepped up and everything worked out perfectly. No Hollywood was able to deliver the hardcore sounds that frenzied fans expected of them, yet the band was still able to surprise them with songs that were creative and fresh. Sixteen Times is a big step for us. That is probably the best song we wrote, Osler says, whose lyrics withhold a catchier tone on this track. I know you like that, Confident, conceited, charming when needed.I know you like that,A boy so admired, handsome and desired. Were good at mixing it up, says Osler. We know how to write the hooks and then we know how to keep it heavy for the kids that want to hear the heavy shit we started out doing. The tracks on Everybodys Talking range from hand-clapping chants with more up-beat guitar sounds presented in ChaChaChastity, to the more hardcore songs with lyrics thatll slap you in the face as seen in Obituary Cover Girl. CLC says that, In this kind of music we just play for kids to go crazy. Theyre just there to have a good time for 40 minutes, go crazy as possible and drive home sweaty. Playing a ridiculous live show for the fans and having fun on stage is what NHE has been about since day one, says Osler. As for challenging themselves musically, NHE just might shock everyone with something highly unanticipated: a fifteen minute bonus track thats a massive medley of eclectic sound effects with an experimental flair, overlapping voice-overs, and lengthy, un-used riffs thatll make your head spin, as CLC describes his favorite part about the album. The name of the album is Everybodys Talking. Everybodys talking everywhere at all times. People are talking somewhere right nowin the next house, the next town, or the next country, says CLC as he explains the albums title which was inspired by the unexpected final track. Even producer, Mike Turner, got a big hit out of the idea. He let us try things, says Osler. The bottom line is, with music and lyrics like No Hollywood Endings slicing through the airwaves, theyre bound to make an impact on some level. I really dont know what to expect, says CLC regarding the future of the band. Just take the band as far as we can take it.

blocks.html:

blocks.text: Denis Lipari - vocals/guitar Nathan Izzi - vocals/bass Ed Solomom - guitar Joe Lipari - drums

blocks.html: RUNAWAY ORANGE is a four piece from Woodbridge, NJ who writes energetic, melodic, catchy, emotional music about relationships, rights of passage, hardships, rising to the occasion, and just letting go. The band believes in living for the moment and takes advantage of every opportunity that comes their way. They have a huge influence from mainstream pop and have been compared to such bands as THIRD EYE BLIND, ALL AMERICAN REJECTS, and JIMMY EAT WORLD. RUNAWAY ORANGE have had the pleasure of touring the US several times as well as visiting Canada on the Drive-Thru Records Stage of the Vans Warped Tour. After finishing up the final touches on their debut full length, The Cutting Room, RUNAWAY ORANGE are anxious to get back on the road to tour the country and spread their unique blend of music to everyone.

sa.title: [ NO MILK RECORDS | SLEEPAWAY ] Buffalo rock band

blocks.html:
Alex Tiberia - guitar/vocals

Shawn Stoyle - drums

Ryan Hoerner - bass

Scott - guitar

Paul - guitar
blocks.text: Alex Tiberia - guitar/vocals Shawn Stoyle - drums Ryan Hoerner - bass Scott - guitar Paul - guitar

blocks.html: Emerging from Buffalo’s prestigious hardcore scene known for bands like Snapcase and Every Time I Die, SLEEPAWAY offers music from the other side of the spectrum. SLEEPAWAY combines shimmering guitar sounds with smooth vocals and piano melodies reminiscent of late 90’s alt rock like The Gin Blossoms and The Goo Goo Dolls.  Formed in the Spring of 2005, with an average age of 19, SLEEPAWAY has been compared to the likes of indie giants Jimmy Eat World, and The Get Up Kids. Although these are monumental or even outlandish assertions, their pristine self titled debut clearly backs this up with a solid collection of 10 tracks each equally as strong as the next.  Their love for vintage gear, alt rock, and meticulous musicianship are key elements driving this band to repeatedly perform and write each and every composition. Their hard work is being reinforced with praise from listeners of all ages and tastes including Gary Malibur (Steve Miller Band), Robby Takac (Goo Goo Dolls), Kevin Ratterman (Elliot), and even a Buffalo Bills cheerleader who features the band in her online profile. With a diverse array of fans, SLEEPAWAY is ready to show the world that Buffalo, NY has more to offer than hardcore, cold climate, and hot wings.

so.title: [ NO MILK RECORDS | SOCRATIC ] Cranford, NJ rock band

blocks.html:
Duane Okun - vocals/guitar

Kevin Bryan II - vocals/guitar

Tom Stratton - drums

Vinny D'Amico - piano/vocals
blocks.text: Duane Okun - vocals/guitar Kevin Bryan II - vocals/guitar Tom Stratton - drums Vinny D'Amico - piano/vocals

blocks.html: Cranford, New Jersey gives birth to the newest musical sensation that stands out in a state cluttered with hundreds of mediocre bands. SOCRATIC has quickly opened the eyes of many people. Following months of non-stop shows within New Jersey and it's surrounding states, SOCRATIC has rapidly grown a fan base within the region. They entered the studio to record their debut EP, It's Getting Late. Produced by Chris Badami (Fenix TX, Dillenger Escape Plan, The Starting Line, Midtown), the CD is a prime example of SOCRATIC's powerful guitars found in bands like Midtown with the classic guitar solos of Guns N Roses. Vocally, SOCRATIC offers amazingly catchy harmonies that have been compared to the likes of Jimmy Eat World, with rougher qualities of bands in the vein of Piebald. SOCRATIC knows how to write an impressive song and rock out accordingly. Their energetic live performances have earned them spots on bills with Hot Water Music, Thrice, the Get up Kids, and dates on the Drive-Thru Records Warped Tour stage. Fans of the genre are noticing this NJ band. A strong work ethic, and the love for the music, is driving them to the top.

blocks.html:
Childhood best friends from Central New Jersey came together in May of 1998 to form The Bank Robbers.


Fueled by raw passion, The Bank Robbers deliver honest, intense songs that bridge the gap between post-hardcore and rock. Intricate, powerful guitars, a solid rhythm section, and soaring vocals take The Bank Robbers a step above their counterparts. With a solid first release of strong melodies and intense musical composition under their belts (2003's The Pattern Reversed), The Bank Robbers have found their place and their sound.


On the evening of May 18, 2005, at The Continental Airlines Arena, Robert Nardone and Vinny Auletta were invited on stage to sing and perform I Still Havent Found What Im Looking For with the legendary U2. The very next day The Bank Robbers were contacted for interviews in a variety of print and digital publications. This larger than life experience was covered with a photo by ROLLING STONE MAGAZINE in the June 16, 2005 issue.


The following month The Bank Robbers entered Underground Sound Studios (Slipknot, Kittie, Biohazard) with producer Mike Turner, to begin tracking their sophomore album. The band was able to take their time, experiment, and capture a record that showcases the bands mature songwriting ability that focuses on structure and chorus, as well energy and passion. The band describes Tomorrow Belongs To Me as a record that listeners of all ages can relate to. It is compiled of a dynamic range of rock songs that showcase the bands love for many different styles of music.


After the sessions were wrapped, The Bank Robbers hit the road with a strenuous tour schedule hitting almost every state in the country. Fresh off a two-month tour of the US with Drive-Thru recording artists Socratic and House of Fools, the band made a stop in Austin, TX to perform at SXSW 2006. Their energetic set caused a frenzy of flash bulbs as photographers rushed to snap pictures of the band breaking glasses while swinging mic stands like baseball bats to create feedback during the bridge of their closing song.


With a solid two-month tour and a spot on the legendary SWSW under their belts, the band plans on touring nonstop throughout the US in the coming months in an attempt to not only gain new fans, but to also showcase their strict work ethic and convey their love for the new record.

blocks.html: tour.ma.line ('turmu`leen) - [noun] 1. a mineral that is a complex borosilicate and hydroxide of aluminum containing iron, magnesium, calcium, lithium, and sodium; it is usually black but occurs in transparent colored forms that are used as gemstones 2. [band] a group hailing from the garden state, preparing to take the music world by storm. Carefully mixing an array of musical influences, from Jeff Buckley to Brand New, Elvis Costello to The Get Up Kids, The Beatles to Elliott Smith, and musically transcending several genres with their unique synth-driven melodies, powerful vocals, and heartfelt lyrics, Tourmaline is guaranteed to 'somehow just blow you away' (utterpunk.com). Matt Rauch, Ryan Baredes, Andrew Koes, Max Rauch, and Corey Zaloom formed Tourmaline early in 2004, and one year later they've found themselves signing to indie label No Milk Records (Socratic / Halifax), recording with producer Chris Bamini (The Early November / The Starting Line), having a track ('Blank') on a nationally distributed Drive Thru Records compilation, and sharing the stage with acts such as Head Automatica, Name Taken, The Beautiful Mistake, Punchline, and many more both in, and out of state. With a full length recently released on No Milk Records and various tours this summer, Tourmaline is showing that they are a musical force to be reckoned with. Combined with a relentless practicing schedule, frequent visits to the studio, powerful songwriting, and a ruthless drive to succeed, Tourmaline is quickly proving that they are indeed a precious gem in today's music world.

news.title: A BLOODY GOOD SHOW AT CHUBBY'S IN RED BANK
news.html:
So tonight No Hollywood Ending is playing Chubby's in Red Bank, NJ. Everyone should come out and check it out. If your up for it come to Red Bank, go to Chubby's and see NHE. They leave for tour soon so lets show them a good farewell.

The Asbury Park Press wrote a killer review that you can read here if your not convinced yet.

news.title: What's On This Week?
news.html:
No Milk Friends & Family Channel only on Bamboozle TV

MONDAY (07.02.07)

Music Mondays (episode 1) Tune in every Monday to see a new music video from a variety of different artists. Maybe you'll discover something new or maybe you'll just get to watch one of yourfavorite videos. This week checkout the latest from Hellogoodbye. Click Here To Watch!

TUESDAY (07.03.07)

Kickin It With Kyse (episode 1) Kyse gets down and dirty with concertgoers at this year's Bamboozle. See who stepped into our confessional booth and hear what they had to say. Today's guest is Denis and he has a little story to tell about a not so little issue. Click Here To Watch!

Erik Von Terrible's Masterpeice Theater (episode 1) Who says entertainment can't be terrible? Certainly not EVT. This week's featured film "Ghost Tears". What happens when your doing housework and a ghost decides to pop in? Watch and see. Click Here To Watch!

WEDNESDAY (07.04.07)

Kickin It With Kyse (episode 2) Kyse gets down and dirty with concertgoers at this years Bamboozle. See who stepped into our confessional booth and hear what they have to say. Today's guest is Rebecca, and she came to speak her mind. Click Here To Watch!

NJFILMCORE (episode 1) What better way to launch NJFILMCORE's debut episode by playing one of our all time favorite skits. Check out "High School Football Highlights" and see what all the fuss is about. Click Here To Watch!

THURSDAY (07.05.07)

Kickin It With Kyse (episode 3) Kyse gets down and dirty with concertgoers at this years Bamboozle. See who stepped into our confessional booth and hear what they have to say. Sometimes we get multiple people in the booth. Today's guests are Willy and Drew, and theyre just chillin. Click Here To Watch!

Cooking With Quigley (episode 1) Hungry? But you're not really a cook. No problem, Quigley offers a simple recipe that will even impress grandma. Get the pad and pen ready and learn how to make delicious, Alumni Wraps. Click Here To Watch!

FRIDAY (07.06.07)

Kickin It With Kyse (episode 4) Kyse gets down and dirty with concertgoers at this years Bamboozle. See who stepped into our confessional booth and hear what they have to say. Today's guest is Jesse,and he brought his own fan club. Click Here To Watch!

Life's A Bitch (episode 1) It most definitely is, and no one knows it better than Frank Redtarp. This week Adam from Halifax will vent his frustrations and reveal a secret so shocking it will make you say. Damn! Life's a Bitch! Click Here To Watch!

New shows every week! So stay informed and watch The No Milk Friends & Family Channel only on Bamboozle TV!

news.title: GET PSYCHED! GET THIS PRE-ORDER!
news.html: Only three weeks until the Earth will align with Saturn and sonic destruction encompasses the United States. NO HOLLYWOOD ENDING "Everybody's Talking" hits the streets. You can pre-order the record now for only $9! Besides a ridiculous metal feast of an album, you also get a signed poster, and a phone call from the band. So if you want NHE to call you, pre-order now! All pre-orders will ship on July 14th! So you might even get it a couple days before it hits shelves!

news.title: NMR CHANNEL LAUNCHES JULY 2ND!
news.html: Frank Redtarp here and your all in for a threat. I just got back from the No Milk studios and had a chance to look at the first cut of Life's A Bitch! Let me tell you, shits gonna be great. Not only was Life's A Bitch hilarious but the other shows were all quality programming. From Music Mondays to Erik Von Terrible's Masterpiece Theater, this stuff is bannanas! So mark it on your calendar, July 2nd the first seaon of The No Milk Records Friends & Family Channel debuts on BamboozleTV.com.

news.title: WE HAVE A THEME SONG
news.html: Special thanks goes out to No-Fi Soul Rebellion, they hooked us up with the intro song to out new TV show, Life's A Bitch. So when your wondering what that funky sound is coming out your computer, remember you heard it hear first. No-Fi Soul Rebellion's "Terrible Muscles" off of there new album, Terrible Muscles. Simply amazing.

news.title: FOSTER GETS THINGS DONE
news.html: We want to give a warm welcome to the newest member of the No Milk work force, Rob Foster. He'll be heading up our video department and we are extremely excited to have him aboard. In the coming weeks he'll be sifting through the no milk tape archives, gathering the goods and getting things ready for the No Milk Record Friends & Family Channel on BamboozleTv. Keep your eye's peeled for more updates in the coming weeks. As a added bonus myself and Foster had a little photo session, check it out.

news.title: WE GIVE ABSOLUTE THANKS
news.html: We just wanted to take the time to thank AbsolutePunk.net for the news post about the NMR Friends & Family sampler vol. 6. We frequent the site often and appreciate the exposure and support that they have given in the past, and continue to give our label.

news.title: LOOKIN GOOD NMR..
news.html: I know traditionally No Milk isn't known for its abundance of news posts. If you click through our archives you'll see many holes in time. Some going as far as three months with only 2 news posts. But lately things are looking different. In those lost months we were growing... gathering... and preparing for the summer ahead. We hope that you will grow with us as we reap the harvest of our bountiful crop that we planted in the fall.

news.title: NMR F&F SAMPLER VOL.6 RADIO?
news.html: Because we want people to hear new music we give out samplers every year at the Bamboozle Festival held in New Jersey. Because we know that everyone doesn't attend this festival we had to do more. We decided to put up a microsite for the sampler where you can listen to any song on the CD and at your own convenience. You should check it out, it's a good one. I personally have had it playing all day while I'm at work. You see I'm alone today at the office. Kyse had official personal buisness to take care of. With the radio stream of the sampler its like having kyse in the office all day long! Check it out for yourself NMR Sampler Vol.6 Microsite

news.title: HOT SHOTS PART DUEX
news.html: We finally updated our personal web site KyleAndGreg.com. At one time this site held our design portfolio from our days in college. The site hadn't been updated in over 2 years. I felt it was finally time to give people the scoop on what's been going on. Learn about our companies from the past, secret hidden pictures, and so much more! GET YOUR ASS TO THE THEATER BABY!

news.title: NHEASY OFFICIALLY ACTIVE
news.html: No Hollywood Ending will soon have a digital home at their new web site domain, NHEASY.COM. We just launched the place holder page, so settle down. But keep your eyes peeled around the start of June for a wild new web site. It will be so NHEasy to remember....

news.title: DEATH TO THE FORUM
news.html: We took down the forum on our NMR Friends And Family web site today. The once mighty forum had been reduced to a who's who of spam and cheap porno sites, woven amongst it's threads like a crippling cancer. Be on the lookout for it's next of kin as we'll be releasing a new site with new features soon! Fuck the forum, we got something better.

news.title: WE KILLED IT AT BAMBOOZLE
news.html:
First off, I would like to thank everyone who stopped by the No Milk Records Friends & Family video studio. This the first year we did something like this and it was a HUGE success. We gave away a ton of promotional stuff including Volume 6 of our sampler and had a great time doing it. Everyone who helped participate in the Kickin It With Kyse booth confessionals did an amazing job. These interviews will be up online at Bamboozle TV shortly.

Frank Redtarp would also like to thank his guests for sharing their personal stories during the taping of Life's A Bitch. If you missed the show, keep your eyes peeled for the interviews with Halifax, No Hollywood Ending, Rookie Of The Year, Treaty of Paris, and T-Bird also online at Bamboozle TV in the near future.

Weekends like this are the reason No Milk Records exists. We made a ton of new friends, and had a great time hanging out with everyone. Thanks for the support from all our fans, friends, and families! You know who you are.

news.title: PLEASE HAMMER... DON'T HURT EM!
news.html: So this weekend while walking to our car late on saturday night, some of the boys from No Milk Records were lucky enough to run into M.C. Hammer! Hammer had played the Bamboozle festival earlier that night and was just chilling by his limo talking to fans. We were some of the lucky ones who got to him early, so we did what anyone would do in that situation. My friend T-Bird said "Yo Hammer, can I get a pic with you and my buddy?". He agreed and I went to take the picture of Hammer and my two fellow colleagues. However when I went to take the pic I realized that there was no way in hell I was going to have a picture of M.C. Hammer in my phone and not be in it, so I jumped in the photo and Kyse took the picture. Later that night we were lucky enough to run into Hammer again, however this time it was at the V.I.P. after party and Hammer was busy watching the boxing match on TV. So two Hammer encounters in one day and a photo to prove it, Bamboozle was fucking awesome!

news.title: MAD PROPS TO THE ADHD CREW
news.html: Special thanks goes out to our boys Swine, Coin and Vulgar for their amazing work on the NMR Friends And Family Studio backdrops. We came to them last minute, the day before Bamboozle and they totally hooked it up! Faster than I could begin to imagine they tagged three amazing 11ft by 7ft back canvas drop cloths that we had brought over. They worked through the night to get it done for the next day and without them our set for the studio would have looked like shit! You can checkout the images on our opening splash page and soon you'll be seeing their work on two new shows debuting only on Bamboozle TV, Kickin it with Kyse and Life's a Bitch!

news.title: BANK ROBBERS NEED YOUR HELP
news.html: The Bank Robbers have been added to the BREAK Battle this Sunday, February 25, 2007. It's at the legendary Stone Pony in Asbury Park, NJ. Come support the band so they can play this year's BAMBOOZLE. They play a little after 8PM. The band has tickets, so contact them at their MySpace. There will be a special guest performing on Victory Records. Come hang!

news.title: PAPER IS FANTASTIC
news.html: So Lady Fantastic are currently on Long Island at Vudu Studios with producer Mike Watts recording their debut album, "Paper". It sounds amazing. They have been keeping some video updates on YouTube. Check the latest one out here.

news.title: What happened to No Milk Records and all the updates? I'm just being real with you man. Didn't you get beat on the scoop by absolutepunk.net?
news.html:
Some of you might be asking yourself where have all the the updates been? There has been alot of crazy things going on at the office, things like BamboozleTV, delicious meals, and a leaking ceiling! But I must be brief as the office is crumbling around me and the time is ticking..I'll explain more soon. Anyway...tomorrow morning two convoys will make the treacherous journey through the frozen tundra to Long Island. Team 1 will be headed by none other than Kyse, a.ka. is Nyse, a.k.a icle, a.k.a Kyle, and Team 2 lead by myself, The Edgemin, and the audio wizard sometimes known as Teeb. There we will meet Mike Watts the producer for Lady Fantastic's new album, "Paper". We will film said events at the studio. Eventually you'll see it, and when you do you'll remember this ridiculous news post. Like I mentioned earlier, all will be revealed.


No news in January!


What? Your stilll reading this... Fine! You want some news... We were hung over and EXTREMELY busy.

news.title: HALIFAX WINS MTV2 DEW CIRCUIT!
news.html: Thanks to everyone who helped make this victory possible. They beat out a bunch of great bands. Your voting really is the main reason they pulled it off. Thanks to all the friends and fans alike. If you didn't get a chance to see the finals, check your local cable listings because reruns will be airing on MTV2!

news.title: LADY FANTASTIC STUDIO DATES ANNOUNCED!
news.html: Lady Fantastic has been hard at work writing their debut full length for No Milk Records. From the demos we have heard already, it sounds amazing. Everyone will be in for a real treat. They will be taking a little trek to Long Island to record the record with producer Mike Watts (As Tall As Lions, Hopesfall, Self Against City) at Vudu Studios starting the third week of March.

news.title: THE BANK ROBBERS IN ALTERNATIVE PRESS!
news.html:
Check out the December Alternative Press issue #221, flip to the AP poll, and read the advice that Rob Nardone, vocalist for The Bank Robbers, has to offer.


No News for October kiddies we take the whole month off and celebrate halloween.

news.title: FANTASTIC FANTASTIC FANTASTIC!
news.html: We would like everyone to give a warm round of applause for Lady Fantastic! These four amazing, hardworking musicians are the latest addition to the No Milk Family. Hailing from Youngstown, OH, Lady Fantastic brings honest, technical, catchy rock songs to the table. Add them mow on MySpace here and listen to some songs. See something fantastic for your self.

news.title: HALF A DECADE, IT FEELS LIKE YESTERDAY!
news.html: I can't believe that half a decade has already gone by since the towers fell. We want to take the time to recognize all the lives of friends, family, and everyone who lost their lives 5 years ago. We can never forget.

news.title: NEW SONGS ON NMR RADIO!
news.html: We've update our playlist on NMR Radio with some real exciting stuff. What kind of stuff you ask? Well for starters we have two new Sleepaway songs, one from the Japanese Import of their brand new record and the other is off a Blink-182 Tribute CD. Not enough? How about a new No Hollywood Ending song and lets not forget my personal favorite No-Fi Soul Rebellion! So give it a listen!

news.title: WHY IS IT SO GREEN AROUND HERE?
news.html: Becasue No-Fi Soul Rebellion is coming! It's official the No-Fi Soul Rebellion's new CD "Alaska Chic" is on its way! We'll be putting up a pre-order very soon so keep your eyes peeled for updates! If you never heard No-Fi Soul Rebellion you might wanna checkout there myspace and give them a good listen, this is sure to be your new favorite band!

news.title: THE BANK ROBBERS & ANBERLIN?
news.html: Tooth and Nail recording artists Anberlin will be stopping in South Hackensack, NJ on their headlining tour. The Bank Robbers will be playing the September 24th date at School of Rock. Buy tickets now! There only 12 Dollars! NO WAY!

news.title: PUNK THE CLOCK E-CARD!
news.html: Our good friends at Punk The Clock have just put out a new e-card advertising their Punk The Clock Vol.2 compilation featuring Emery, The Bank Robbers, Anberlin, Emanuel, and many more amazing artisits! I suggest you check out this e-card, you'll soon realize that this comp is a must have! Check it out here!

news.title: SUMMER IS SO HOT SALE!!!!
news.html: It's no secret that this summer is shaping up to be one of the hottest years yet! Luckly for you, the heat has drove us mad and No Milk Records has decided to have our biggest sale yet! You'll find poster, buttons, hats, tshirts and a whole lot more all marked half priced! This is for limited time only and some of the items on sale will not be manufactored again so check out our SUMMER IS SO HOT SALE! RIGHT NOW BEFORE ITS TOO LATE!!!!

news.title: THE BANK ROBBERS AND SLEEPAWAY ROCK BUFFALO TOGETHER!
news.html: SLEEPAWAY and THE BANK ROBBERS are going to be playing the brand new Buffalo Superstore July 29th in Buffalo, NY! The store is at the McKinley Mall and will start at 2PM. Both bands will be performing and signing copies of their new record! 2 bands for free! Let's get all of Buffalo to this event!

news.title: THE BANK ROBBERS IN BRAZIL!
news.html: THE BANK ROBBERS are going to be released on an International split representing the USA to be released this September in Brazil on Enemy One Records. The split is called, "We Are Not Enemies, But Friends". Check out the tracklisting here.

news.title: NO HOLLYWOOD ENDING MONSTER TOUR!
news.html: NO HOLLYWOOD ENDING will embark on their largest tour to date with Gray Lines Of Perfection. With over 30 shows, the band will be bringing along smoke and bubble machines, as well as their own lights. If you haven't had a chance to see this band live you better get to one of these shows! Go listen to a new track called, "Hot Without A Heartbeat", on their myspace now!

news.title: SLEEPAWAY RELEASED IN JAPAN!
news.html: SLEEPAWAY's debut full length is out now in Japan through Fabtone Records. The import features 2 unreleased B sides for those die hard fans. Pick it up if you love imports and need more music from SLEEPAWAY!

news.title: MORE FYE IN STORES FOR SLEEPAWAY!
news.html: More FYE In Store performances have been added throughout the north for SLEEPAWAY. Syracuse, Rochester, and Erie PA are the cities they will be appearing at. Come out and support this amazing band.

news.title: ROCKAWAY FYE IN STORE VIDEO!
news.html: The instores are going great. Click here to see THE BANK ROBBERS performing "Facing Our Nightmare" at the Rockaway, NJ instore that a fan shot.

news.title: SLEEPAWAY CD RELEASE SHOW!
news.html: After the last CD release show was cancelled, the band was asked to headline the Buffalo Icon with a couple friends including Speakerfire, and Standard of Living. The show will be taking place this Saturday, July 1st. This is definitely a show you do not want to miss.

news.title: MORE FYE IN STORES FOR THE BANK ROBBERS!
news.html: More FYE In Store performances have been added throughout the region for THE BANK ROBBERS. Long Island, Rockaway, Vineland, and West Nyack are the cities they will be appearing at. Tell all your friends.

news.title: MOXIESTAR PUBLICITY!
news.html: Check out an amazing publicity company, Moxie Star! They have been working the SLEEPAWAY record and doing a bang up job. Check them out for all your publicity needs.

news.title: BEST OF LUCK TO SLEEPAWAY
news.html: On June 9th Sleepaway will be playing a FREE instore performance at F.Y.E (Walden Galleria Mall ) at 7pm sharp! ( 2000 WALDEN AVE STE G203, BUFFALO, NY) This is going to be an amazing show! I'd like to send my personal well wishes to the band, Kyle & Ace because I was unable to attend. Best of luck guys and get home safely!

news.title: TOMORROW BELONGS TO THE EVIL SOUND OF TBR AND SLEEPAWAY
news.html: Head over to TomorrowBelongsToTBR.com we've posted some new reviews and band features!!! Then once you've done that checkout EvilHasANewSound.com for the latest in Sleepaway reviews and features!! Two great sites, all for you! Damn No Milk your good.

news.title: SLEEPAWAY CD INSTORES TODAY!!
news.html: Sleepaway's debut s/t CD is now available in stores acorss the country!!! If your store doesn't carry it, hassle them till they do!
